description: In every PA-model, entry at a successor index in a constructed list is entry at the preceding index in its tail.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listEntry_cons_successor_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (a c i : M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listEntry.value
      ![Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listCons.value ![a, c],
        Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M i] =
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listEntry.value ![c, i]
